allocations.exactDerivedText: A new ChatGPT ad can open a separate conversation with the seller
OpenAI announced September 16 that it is testing Sponsored Agents with select US advertisers.
After clicking an ad in ChatGPT, a person can choose to open a clearly labelled conversation with an agent sponsored by that business.
OpenAI says the sponsored conversation is separate from the person’s original chat and from ChatGPT’s independent answers.
The announcement does not give broader availability details.
You are talking to a seller about what it offers, through an AI agent inside ChatGPT.
The important hand-off happens when you click the ad and choose the new conversation.
Pause there long enough to notice the label and who is speaking.
After the ad click, you’re chatting with the seller.
